narrative: Material PL2__M6008FBB exhibits erratic demand (CV=0.61) with a statistically significant upward trend of ~1,145 units/day over 221 working days. Lead times are unstable (CV=0.78) but very short, averaging 1.04 days. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy using EOQ (66,949 units) is recommended, reducing safety stock by 14.5% versus SAP while maintaining 95% service level and saving $119,005 annually.
warnings: High demand variability (CV > 0.5) increases forecast uncertainty
Unstable lead times (CV > 0.6) pose supply chain risk
Significant demand trend detected (slope=1145 units/day, p<0.05)

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is near-continuous (96.8% non-zero) and high-volume, making continuous-review appropriate. EOQ exceeds MOQ, enabling economically driven batch sizing rather than MOQ-constrained ordering.
research_insights.boundary_risk: No capacity constraint binding. Max post-replenishment inventory (351,652) is well below the 4,490,135 unit storage limit.
